hero.title: My profile
hero.text: Everything about your identity, your business, and your access to FLUX.

info.title: Personal and professional information
info.text: This information stays private and is used to personalize your experience.

adventure.canCreateText: A few questions are all it takes: FLUX prepares the foundation and you stay in control of everything.
adventure.limitText: Your plan has reached its project limit. You can manage your existing showcases.

invite.title: Invite a friend
invite.text: Introduce FLUX to a business owner you know: they get an invitation and 7 days of free trial.

credits.trialOver: Trial over — choose your FLUX plan

license.title: License of use
license.text: You remain the owner of the information and content you add. FLUX grants you a personal right to use the service, with no transfer of ownership over the platform.

security.title: Security
security.text: Manage your credentials with secure email validations, or log out on this device.

passwordForm.title: Password
passwordForm.text: Receive a secure link at your current email address to choose a new password.

emailForm.title: Email address
emailForm.text: Your current address is {email}. Changing it requires confirmation from both the old and new address.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.text: Deleting your account permanently erases your account, showcases, customers, orders, appointments, and content. This action is irreversible.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Your subscription, due dates, and invoices all in one place.
billing.portalUnavailable: The billing portal is temporarily unavailable.
billing.help: The secure Stripe portal lets you update your payment method, download invoices, change plans, or cancel.

errors.name_required: Please enter at least your name.
errors.email_send_failed: Unable to send the email right now.
errors.already_current_email: This is already your current address.
errors.email_change_failed: Unable to start the email change.
errors.content_blocked: Hate speech or explicit content is forbidden and penalized on FLUX; please respect your environment and that of others. After 3 violations of our terms of use, the account is deleted.
errors.unknown: An error occurred. Please try again in a moment.

messages.reset_email_sent: An email has already been sent.
messages.reset_email_sent_fresh: Email sent to your current address. The link is temporary and single-use.
messages.email_change_pending: A request is already in progress. Check both of your inboxes.
messages.email_change_requested: Request sent. Your address will only change once confirmed from both your current and new address.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.text: Get an alert on this device as soon as an order or a booking comes in, even when FLUX is closed.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser. Allow them in the site settings.
